reason: The cited evidence does not directly support the key premises. E1 discusses density reduction via Al addition in different alloys, not Nb-for-Ta substitution, and notes plasticity deterioration. E2 describes solid-solution strengthening calculations for MoNbTaW but provides no data on HfMoTaTiZr or the effect of Nb substitution on density or strength retention. The baseline properties and the claimed chemical similarity are not evidenced in the cited passages.
premises: Nb and Ta are chemically similar with similar atomic sizes, preserving solid-solution strengthening
Substituting Ta (atomic weight ~181) with Nb (~93) reduces average atomic weight and thus density
The modified alloy will retain a homogeneous single-phase BCC structure
As-cast HfMoTaTiZr baseline has density ~10.21 g/cm³, RT yield ~1600 MPa, 1000 °C yield ~855 MPa
